messages:
Lucas: Quick sync — following the postmortem for the cache thrash incident. We need a small but concrete set of runbook/playbook updates and clear owners + timelines.

Jamie: +1. Main gaps were: unclear escalation after prefix cache blowup, no quick triage commands, and missing fallback model variant in the playbook.

Maya: Proposed: 1) escalation matrix explicit times (0m ack oncall, 5m notify eng-oncall, 15m page eng-lead), 2) `kubectl` + runtime checks in triage steps, 3) rollback to quantized variant as fallback.

Raj: For triage steps, add these snippets:```bash
# check pod logs for OOMs
kubectl -n inference logs $(kubectl -n inference get pods -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') | tail -n 200
# inspect redis memory
redis-cli -h redis.svc.cluster.local INFO memory
```
Put them under "Initial Triage" section.

Lucas: @jamie can you own the escalation matrix edit? Target EOD Friday for a PR.

Jamie: I can. I'll open a PR against infra/playbooks/runbooks with the matrix and a short rationale. Assigning to me: `jamie`. Due: 2026-04-03.

Maya: I'll update the triage checklist and add the commands + example outputs. Assigning to me: `maya`. Due: 2026-04-05.

Raj: I'll add the fallback variant details (model id, expected perf delta, and how to force route) into the playbook. Assigning to me: `raj`. Due: 2026-04-06.

Anna: Can we add a short section on recurrence signals (e.g., cache eviction frequency > X/min, repeated request latency spikes for same user cohort) so SREs can flag regression trends? I can draft the threshold suggestions. Assigning to me: `anna`. Due: 2026-04-07.

karen-bot: Task created: TASK-4587 "Escalation matrix + triage commands" assigned jamie, maya, raj, anna. Due 2026-04-07.

Lucas: Good. One more thing — add a short runbook snippet for safe cache flush: `curl -X POST https://admin.internal/flush-prefix -d '{"prefix":"user-kv"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'` and warn about blowback if you flush global prefix.

Jamie: I'll include that with a gating step: must confirm with oncall lead before running.

Maya: Also adding a verification step post-fix: run `curl https://metrics.internal/api?query=cache_miss_rate` and confirm miss rate falls by >50% within 10m.

Lucas: Thanks all. I'll follow up in the postmortem doc with a table of owners/due dates and will schedule a 15m check-in the week after due dates to verify PRs merged and playbook staged.

Raj: FYI - I noticed a recurring pattern in last 3 incidents: rapid small bursts then KV growth. I'll include a short note and link to the telemetry query in the playbook so oncall can identify pattern quickly.

Anna: If any of the owners need a hand on wording or code snippets ping me.

Lucas: Action list summary: jamie -> escalation matrix (EOD 04/03), maya -> triage + commands (04/05), raj -> fallback variant + safe ops (04/06), anna -> recurrence thresholds (04/07). Check-in after 04/08. :white_check_mark:

Maya: PR opened: GH:infra/playbooks#876, draft. Will request reviews from lucas + jamie.

Jamie: PR opened for matrix: GH:infra/playbooks#877. tagging eng-leads.

karen-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up meeting on 2026-04-09 16:00 UTC for playbook review.
